Messages.Author: Jeff Dai
Messages.Body:
Back to this card again.

When you are taking actions with the Madness Network (ie after an opponent
declares their minion phase over) is this considered your own seperate
minion phase?

The reason I ask is a combination that I noticed just recently. What
happens when Rutor's Hand and Madness Network are applied together. If
the minion with Rutor's Hand takes an action after each methuselah's
minion phase does he get to untap?

Here's something scary too. Masika, Clan Impersonation (Malkavian),
Madness Network. Masika bleeds. Opponent finishes influence. Masika
untaps, ready to block o do anything else.

Another question: What happens to clan specific cards when Clan
Impersonation goes into effect? For example an Aching Beauty on a
Toreador when that vampire becomes a Nos? Does the vampire lose aching
beauty? How about a Toreador Grand Ball already targeted? Resplendant
protector still protect a Nos?

Thanks for the help

Jeff

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Madness Network does not allow you to treat the end of each minion phase
as your own little minion phase. For example, because it is not your
turn, you cannot use action cards or action modifiers during a Networked
action.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
